---
title: "Contributing"
subtitle: "Issues, pull requests, and how the repository is laid out."
---

Contributions are welcome.
Open an [issue](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-codespaces/issues) for a bug or a request, or a [pull request](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-codespaces/pulls) for a change you have already made.

## Repository layout

::: {.codespaces-tags}

| Path | Contains |
| --- | --- |
| `.devcontainer/` | The consumer-facing [configurations](reference/configurations.qmd). |
| `.devcontainer/universal/` | The universal configuration and its vendored copies of two features. |
| `.github/.devcontainer/` | The build recipe and the six local [Dev Container features](reference/features.qmd). |
| `.github/workflows/` | Image builds, security scanning, release, and documentation deployment. |
| `docs/` | This website. |
| `init-env.sh` | The [environment initialisation script](reference/init-env.qmd). |

:::

## Changing a feature

The `uv` and `quarto-computing-dependencies` features exist twice, once under `.github/.devcontainer/` and once under `.devcontainer/universal/`.
The `check-feature-sync` job runs `diff -r` on both pairs and fails the build if they differ, so apply every change to both copies.

## Changing an image

Opening a pull request builds the release and prerelease images on both architectures and runs `quarto check` inside them, without publishing anything.
The check output lands in the workflow run summary.

## Changing the documentation

The site is a Quarto project in `docs/`, built with the [Atelier](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-atelier/) project type.

```sh
quarto preview docs
```

The `quarto check` transcripts on the [Quarto check output](reference/quarto-check.qmd) page are written by the build workflow.
Edit the prose around them, but leave the `QUARTO_CHECK_*` comment markers in place.

Merging to `main` deploys the site to GitHub Pages.
